turns.patient_response: I’ve been having a lot of trouble with my eating lately. I’m barely eating anything most days, skipping meals on purpose and really cutting back on calories, and I’ve been losing quite a bit of weight. My family is pretty worried, and I guess I’m starting to wonder if it’s gotten out of hand.
